# Source: The five highest and five lowest of California's 52 districts. Urban Institute, American Affordability Tracker (ODC-BY 1.0): unsubsidized second-lowest-cost Silver premium for a 40-year-old, averaged by population. Most Covered California members pay much less after subsidies. Urban builds district values from county prices, so districts inside one county often share a value; 10 districts tie at the lowest.
